research_evidence: GitHub recommends ephemeral self-hosted runners for autoscaling and external retention of ephemeral runner diagnostics.
GitHub actions/scaleset is the official custom-autoscaling client outside Kubernetes and provides scale-set polling/JIT primitives.
GitLab warns that non-ephemeral multi-project runners increase compromise risk and recommends single-job ephemeral instances plus network segmentation.
Buildkite recommends compartmentalized agents, expiring agents after jobs and scoped caches.
systemd on cgroup v2 supports the required process/filesystem/device/network/resource policy family.
NVIDIA CDI supports specific GPU injection and improves compatibility with rootless containers, making rootless Podman a later hardening option.
GitHub warns caches are unsigned/unverified; persistent candidate-writable cache state is therefore excluded from the trusted pilot design.
